# Analysis specification

The pupil measure previously labeled Rate of Dilation is reported as **Net Pupil Change**. Its values and calculation are unchanged. Legacy dataset columns `RodDiff` and `RodDiff2` retain their names for compatibility; see `code/pd_measure_dictionary.csv`.

This document contains the revised statistical analysis for PONE-D-26-14553.

The analysis is reconstructed from the original raw dataset. Previously imputed
or processed analysis datasets are not used.

Primary analyses comprise three postpartum binary outcomes:

1. Depressive symptoms: EPDS >= 12
2. State anxiety symptoms: STAI-S >= 40
3. Trait anxiety symptoms: STAI-T >= 40

For each outcome, two elastic-net logistic regression models will be evaluated:

- Reference model: 32 background and psychological predictors
- Full model: the same 32 predictors plus 10 pupil-dilation predictors

Model development and internal validation will use the complete analytic cohort
and bootstrap-first multiple imputation. The complete modelling procedure,
including imputation and hyperparameter tuning, will be incorporated within
bootstrap internal validation.

This document calculates missingness directly from the unimputed analytic dataset.
Postpartum outcome values are not imputed.

# 1. Data import and analytic cohort
```{r}

raw_file <- here(
  "data",
  "raw",
  "3PADCombined_R_allSubs_25Oct26.xlsx"
)

stopifnot(file.exists(raw_file))

cat("Raw dataset rows:", nrow(df_raw), "\n")
cat("Raw dataset columns:", ncol(df_raw), "\n")
```

## 1.1 Define analysis cohort 
```{r}

#| label: define-analysis-cohort

# Define participants with all three observed postpartum outcomes
df_raw$has_postpartum_outcomes <-
  !is.na(df_raw$ppv6_epds_sum) &
  !is.na(df_raw$ppv6_stai_s_sum) &
  !is.na(df_raw$ppv6_stai_t_sum)

# Participant-flow summary
cohort_flow <- tibble(
  category = c(
    "Raw records",
    "Postpartum outcomes unavailable",
    "Final analytic cohort"
  ),
  n = c(
    nrow(df_raw),
    sum(!df_raw$has_postpartum_outcomes),
    sum(df_raw$has_postpartum_outcomes)
  )
)

cohort_flow

# Create analytic cohort
df <- df_raw %>%
  filter(has_postpartum_outcomes)

# Reproducibility checks
stopifnot(nrow(df_raw) == 99)
stopifnot(nrow(df) == 91)

cat("Analytic cohort:", nrow(df), "participants\n")
```

# 2. Data and analysis setup

## 2.1 Variable construction
```{r}

#| label: construct-background-variables

df <- df %>%
  mutate(

    # BMI
    gb1_weight = as.numeric(gb1_weight),
    bmi = gb1_weight / ((gb1_height / 100)^2),

    # Country of birth: Sweden vs other
    country = case_when(
      is.na(gb1_country) ~ NA_character_,
      str_detect(gb1_country, regex("sverige", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Sweden",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    country = factor(country, levels = c("Other", "Sweden")),

    # Education
    edu = case_when(
      is.na(gb1_edu___4) ~ NA_character_,
      gb1_edu___4 == 1 ~ "University",
      TRUE ~ "Less"
    ),
    edu = factor(edu, levels = c("Less", "University")),

    # First pregnancy - this is NOT parity
    first_preg = case_when(
      is.na(gb1_first_preg) ~ NA_character_,
      gb1_first_preg == 1 ~ "Yes",
      gb1_first_preg == 0 ~ "No"
    ),
    first_preg = factor(first_preg, levels = c("No", "Yes")),

    # Full-time employment, self-employment, or study
    workFT = if_else(
      if_any(
        c(
          gb1_job_work___1,
          gb1_job_business___1,
          gb1_job_student___1
        ),
        ~ . > 0
      ),
      "Full-time",
      "Other",
      missing = NA_character_
    ),
    workFT = factor(workFT, levels = c("Other", "Full-time")),

    # PCOS
    # REDCap code 1 = yes; other observed response categories collapsed to no,
    # matching the original analysis
    pcos = case_when(
      is.na(gb1_pcos) ~ NA_character_,
      gb1_pcos == 1 ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    ),
    pcos = factor(pcos, levels = c("No", "Yes")),

    # Exercise
    # Original coding: 1-3 = moderate/high; 4-5 = low/none
    exercise1 = case_when(
      is.na(gb1_exercise) ~ NA_character_,
      gb1_exercise >= 4 ~ "Low to none",
      TRUE ~ "Moderate to high"
    ),
    exercise1 = factor(
      exercise1,
      levels = c("Low to none", "Moderate to high")
    ),

    exercise2 = case_when(
      is.na(gb2_exercise) ~ NA_character_,
      gb2_exercise >= 4 ~ "Low to none",
      TRUE ~ "Moderate to high"
    ),
    exercise2 = factor(
      exercise2,
      levels = c("Low to none", "Moderate to high")
    ),

    # SSRI use during early pregnancy
    SSRI = case_when(
      is.na(gb1_meds_ja___6) ~ NA_character_,
      gb1_meds_ja___6 == 1 ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    ),
    SSRI = factor(SSRI, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  )



df <- df %>%
  mutate(

    # Positive life experiences
    pos_LE1 = case_when(
      is.na(gb1_pos_lifeevents) ~ NA_character_,
      gb1_pos_lifeevents == 1 ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ "Yes"
    ),
    pos_LE1 = factor(pos_LE1, levels = c("No", "Yes")),

    pos_LE2 = case_when(
      is.na(gb2_pos_lifeevents) ~ NA_character_,
      gb2_pos_lifeevents == 1 ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ "Yes"
    ),
    pos_LE2 = factor(pos_LE2, levels = c("No", "Yes")),

    # Negative life experiences
    neg_LE1 = case_when(
      is.na(gb1_neg_lifeevents) ~ NA_character_,
      gb1_neg_lifeevents == 1 ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ "Yes"
    ),
    neg_LE1 = factor(neg_LE1, levels = c("No", "Yes")),

    neg_LE2 = case_when(
      is.na(gb2_neg_lifeevents) ~ NA_character_,
      gb2_neg_lifeevents == 1 ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ "Yes"
    ),
    neg_LE2 = factor(neg_LE2, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  )

```

## 4.2 MICE helper function
```{r}

#| label: single-level-predictor-safeguard

fill_single_level_missing <- function(
  data,
  predictor_vars
) {

  fill_log <- tibble(
    variable = character(),
    n_missing_filled = integer(),
    fill_value = character()
  )

  for (v in predictor_vars) {

    x <- data[[v]]

    n_missing <- sum(is.na(x))

    if (n_missing == 0) {
      next
    }

    observed <- x[!is.na(x)]

    n_unique_observed <-
      dplyr::n_distinct(observed)

    # If absolutely everything is missing, there is
    # no information available for imputation.
    if (n_unique_observed == 0) {

      stop(
        paste0(
          "Predictor '",
          v,
          "' is completely missing in this bootstrap sample."
        )
      )
    }

    # If all observed values are identical, MICE cannot
    # estimate an imputation model. Fill missing observations
    # with the only value represented in the bootstrap sample.
    if (n_unique_observed == 1) {

      fill_value <- observed[1]

      x[is.na(x)] <- fill_value

      data[[v]] <- x

      fill_log <- bind_rows(
        fill_log,
        tibble(
          variable = v,
          n_missing_filled = n_missing,
          fill_value = as.character(fill_value)
        )
      )
    }
  }

  list(
    data = data,
    fill_log = fill_log
  )
}
```


## 4.3. DEVELOPMENT MICE specification function 
```{r}

#| label: make-mice-specification-development

make_mice_spec_development <- function(data, outcome_var,predictor_vars = full_vars) {

  imp_data <- data %>%
    select(
      all_of(predictor_vars),
      all_of(outcome_var)
    )
  
  single_level_fix <- fill_single_level_missing(
  data = imp_data,
  predictor_vars = predictor_vars
)

imp_data <- single_level_fix$data
single_level_fill_log <- single_level_fix$fill_log

  ini <- mice::mice(
    imp_data,
    maxit = 0,
    printFlag = FALSE
  )

  method <- ini$method
  predictor_matrix <- ini$predictorMatrix

  # Turn everything off initially
  method[] <- ""
  predictor_matrix[,] <- 0

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Imputation methods
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
continuous_present <- intersect(
  continuous_vars,
  predictor_vars
)

continuous_missing <- continuous_present[
  map_lgl(
    imp_data[continuous_present],
    ~ any(is.na(.x))
  )
]

method[continuous_missing] <- "pmm"


binary_present <- intersect(
  binary_vars,
  predictor_vars
)

binary_missing <- binary_present[
  map_lgl(
    imp_data[binary_present],
    ~ any(is.na(.x))
  )
]



  # Binary predictors:
# CART is used because bootstrap resampling can create
# sparse/separated logistic imputation models.
method[binary_missing] <- "cart"
  

  # Outcome is observed only
  method[outcome_var] <- ""

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Core predictors available to imputation models
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  core_vars <- c(
    "gb1_age",
    "bmi",

    "gb1_epds_sum",
    "gb2_epds_sum",

    "gb1_stai_s_sum",
    "gb2_stai_s_sum",

    "gb1_stai_t_sum",
    "gb2_stai_t_sum",

    "gb1_gad7_sum",
    "gb2_gad7_sum",

    "gb1_pss_sum",
    "gb2_pss_sum",

    outcome_var
  )

  core_vars <- intersect(
    core_vars,
    names(imp_data)
  )

  # Every variable being imputed can use the core predictors
  vars_to_impute <- names(method)[method != ""]

  predictor_matrix[
    vars_to_impute,
    core_vars
  ] <- 1

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Paired early/late variables
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  paired_vars <- list(
    c("exercise1", "exercise2"),
    c("pos_LE1", "pos_LE2"),
    c("neg_LE1", "neg_LE2"),

    c("gb1_epds_sum", "gb2_epds_sum"),
    c("gb1_stai_s_sum", "gb2_stai_s_sum"),
    c("gb1_stai_t_sum", "gb2_stai_t_sum"),
    c("gb1_ders16_sum", "gb2_ders16_sum"),
    c("gb1_saaq_sum", "gb2_saaq_sum"),
    c("gb1_rs14_sum", "gb2_rs14_sum"),
    c("gb1_pss_sum", "gb2_pss_sum"),
    c("gb1_soc13_sum", "gb2_soc13_sum"),
    c("gb1_gad7_sum", "gb2_gad7_sum"),

    c("PARDiff", "PARDiff2"),
    c("RodDiff", "RodDiff2"),
    c("PCUDiff", "PCUDiff2"),
    c("PAADiff", "PAADiff2"),
    c("PTRDiff", "PTRDiff2")
  )

  for (pair in paired_vars) {

    a <- pair[1]
    b <- pair[2]

    if (
      a %in% vars_to_impute &&
      b %in% names(imp_data)
    ) {
      predictor_matrix[a, b] <- 1
    }

    if (
      b %in% vars_to_impute &&
      a %in% names(imp_data)
    ) {
      predictor_matrix[b, a] <- 1
    }
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Let PD variables inform one another
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  pd_present <- intersect(
    pd_vars,
    names(imp_data)
  )

  for (v in intersect(vars_to_impute, pd_present)) {

    other_pd <- setdiff(pd_present, v)

    predictor_matrix[
      v,
      other_pd
    ] <- 1
  }

  # Never use a variable to predict itself
  diag(predictor_matrix) <- 0

  # Outcome must never be imputed
  predictor_matrix[outcome_var, ] <- 0

  list(
  data = imp_data,
  method = method,
  predictor_matrix = predictor_matrix,
  single_level_fill_log = single_level_fill_log
)
}
```

```{r}
  # Outcome is observed only
  method[outcome_var] <- ""

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Core predictors available to imputation models
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  core_vars <- c(
    "gb1_age",
    "bmi",

    "gb1_epds_sum",
    "gb2_epds_sum",

    "gb1_stai_s_sum",
    "gb2_stai_s_sum",

    "gb1_stai_t_sum",
    "gb2_stai_t_sum",

    "gb1_gad7_sum",
    "gb2_gad7_sum",

    "gb1_pss_sum",
    "gb2_pss_sum",

    outcome_var
  )

  core_vars <- intersect(
    core_vars,
    names(imp_data)
  )

  # Every variable being imputed can use the core predictors
  vars_to_impute <- names(method)[method != ""]

  predictor_matrix[
    vars_to_impute,
    core_vars
  ] <- 1

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Paired early/late variables
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  paired_vars <- list(
    c("exercise1", "exercise2"),
    c("pos_LE1", "pos_LE2"),
    c("neg_LE1", "neg_LE2"),

    c("gb1_epds_sum", "gb2_epds_sum"),
    c("gb1_stai_s_sum", "gb2_stai_s_sum"),
    c("gb1_stai_t_sum", "gb2_stai_t_sum"),
    c("gb1_ders16_sum", "gb2_ders16_sum"),
    c("gb1_saaq_sum", "gb2_saaq_sum"),
    c("gb1_rs14_sum", "gb2_rs14_sum"),
    c("gb1_pss_sum", "gb2_pss_sum"),
    c("gb1_soc13_sum", "gb2_soc13_sum"),
    c("gb1_gad7_sum", "gb2_gad7_sum"),

    c("PARDiff", "PARDiff2"),
    c("RodDiff", "RodDiff2"),
    c("PCUDiff", "PCUDiff2"),
    c("PAADiff", "PAADiff2"),
    c("PTRDiff", "PTRDiff2")
  )

  for (pair in paired_vars) {

    a <- pair[1]
    b <- pair[2]

    if (
      a %in% vars_to_impute &&
      b %in% names(imp_data)
    ) {
      predictor_matrix[a, b] <- 1
    }

    if (
      b %in% vars_to_impute &&
      a %in% names(imp_data)
    ) {
      predictor_matrix[b, a] <- 1
    }
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Let PD variables inform one another
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  pd_present <- intersect(
    pd_vars,
    names(imp_data)
  )

  for (v in intersect(vars_to_impute, pd_present)) {

    other_pd <- setdiff(pd_present, v)

    predictor_matrix[
      v,
      other_pd
    ] <- 1
  }

  # Never use a variable to predict itself
  diag(predictor_matrix) <- 0

  # Outcome must never be imputed
  predictor_matrix[outcome_var, ] <- 0

  # Validation outcome must also NOT be used
# to impute any predictor
predictor_matrix[, outcome_var] <- 0

list(
  data = imp_data,
  method = method,
  predictor_matrix = predictor_matrix,
  single_level_fill_log = single_level_fill_log
)
}
```

# 6. Build bootstrap-first MI engine

## 6.1 Stratified grouped CV folds
```{r}
#| label: make-cv-folds

#| label: make-cv-folds

make_stratified_group_folds <- function(
  data,
  outcome_var,
  k = 10,
  seed = NULL
) {

  if (!is.null(seed)) {
    set.seed(seed)
  }

  # One row per original participant,
  # regardless of how many times that participant
  # occurs in the bootstrap sample
  unique_people <- data %>%
    transmute(
      pid = pid,
      outcome = .data[[outcome_var]]
    ) %>%
    distinct()

  # Distribute event and non-event participants
  # across folds as evenly as possible
  fold_map <- unique_people %>%
    group_by(outcome) %>%
    mutate(
      fold = sample(
        rep(
          seq_len(k),
          length.out = n()
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  foldid <- fold_map$fold[
    match(data$pid, fold_map$pid)
  ]

  # Safety check:
  # every copy of the same PID must be in the same fold
  pid_fold_check <- tibble(
    pid = data$pid,
    fold = foldid
  ) %>%
    group_by(pid) %>%
    summarise(
      n_folds = n_distinct(fold),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  stopifnot(
    all(pid_fold_check$n_folds == 1)
  )

  foldid
}
```


## 6.2 Create matching model matrices
Factors have to produce exactly the same dummy-variable columns in development and validation data.

```{r}
#| label: model-matrix-helper

make_model_matrices <- function(
  train_data,
  validation_data,
  predictor_vars
) {

  x_train <- model.matrix(
    ~ .,
    data = train_data %>%
      select(all_of(predictor_vars))
  )

  x_validation <- model.matrix(
    ~ .,
    data = validation_data %>%
      select(all_of(predictor_vars))
  )

  # Remove intercept: glmnet handles its own intercept
  x_train <- x_train[
    ,
    colnames(x_train) != "(Intercept)",
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  x_validation <- x_validation[
    ,
    colnames(x_validation) != "(Intercept)",
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  all_columns <- union(
    colnames(x_train),
    colnames(x_validation)
  )

  align_matrix <- function(x, columns) {

    out <- matrix(
      0,
      nrow = nrow(x),
      ncol = length(columns),
      dimnames = list(NULL, columns)
    )

    out[, colnames(x)] <- x

    out
  }

  list(
    train = align_matrix(
      x_train,
      all_columns
    ),
    validation = align_matrix(
      x_validation,
      all_columns
    )
  )
}
```


## 6.3 Elastic-net fitting and tuning
- α = 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00
- stratified grouped 5-fold CV
- binomial deviance
- lambda.min
- glmnet standardization

```{r}
#| label: fit-elastic-net

fit_elastic_net <- function(
  train_data,
  validation_data,
  outcome_var,
  predictor_vars,
  alpha_grid = c(
    0.10,
    0.25,
    0.50,
    0.75,
    1.00
  ),
  k = 10,
  seed = 1
) {

  if (as.character(utils::packageVersion("glmnet")) != "5.0") {
    stop("The verified analyses used glmnet 5.0. Load the saved corrected results, or restore that version before refitting models.")
  }

  matrices <- make_model_matrices(
    train_data = train_data,
    validation_data = validation_data,
    predictor_vars = predictor_vars
  )

  x_train <- matrices$train
  x_validation <- matrices$validation

  y_train <- train_data[[outcome_var]]

  stopifnot(!anyNA(x_train))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(x_validation))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(y_train))

  foldid <- make_stratified_group_folds(
  data = train_data,
  outcome_var = outcome_var,
  k = k,
  seed = seed

  )
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
# Diagnose outcome sparsity within inner CV
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cv_fold_diagnostics <- map_dfr(
  sort(unique(foldid)),
  function(f) {

    training_rows <- foldid != f

    tibble(
      fold = f,

      n_train = sum(training_rows),

      n_events_train =
        sum(y_train[training_rows] == 1),

      n_non_events_train =
        sum(y_train[training_rows] == 0),

      n_unique_events_train =
        n_distinct(
          train_data$pid[
            training_rows &
            y_train == 1
          ]
        ),

      n_unique_non_events_train =
        n_distinct(
          train_data$pid[
            training_rows &
            y_train == 0
          ]
        )
    )
  }
)

  # Capture glmnet warnings so that large bootstrap runs
# do not fill the Console with repeated messages.

glmnet_warnings <- character()

capture_glmnet_warnings <- function(expr) {

  withCallingHandlers(
    expr,

    warning = function(w) {

      glmnet_warnings <<- c(
        glmnet_warnings,
        conditionMessage(w)
      )

      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )
}
  # Use identical fold assignments for every alpha
  cv_models <- map(
    alpha_grid,
    function(a) {

     capture_glmnet_warnings(
  glmnet::cv.glmnet(
    x = x_train,
    y = y_train,
    family = "binomial",
    alpha = a,
    foldid = foldid,
    type.measure = "deviance",
    grouped = FALSE,
    standardize = TRUE
  )
)
    }
  )

  # Compare alpha values using their minimum CV deviance
  cv_deviance <- map_dbl(
    cv_models,
    ~ min(.x$cvm, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  best_index <- which.min(cv_deviance)

  best_alpha <- alpha_grid[best_index]
  best_cv <- cv_models[[best_index]]
  best_lambda <- best_cv$lambda.min

  # Refit final model on the complete development sample
  final_fit <- capture_glmnet_warnings(
  glmnet::glmnet(
    x = x_train,
    y = y_train,
    family = "binomial",
    alpha = best_alpha,
    lambda = best_lambda,
    standardize = TRUE
  )
)

  # Numerical safeguard for full models: a failed standalone fit is refitted
  # along a warm-start path to the SAME CV-selected alpha and lambda.
  # This reproduces the documented repairs without changing cached baseline fits.
  if (identical(predictor_vars, full_vars) && final_fit$jerr != 0L) {
    regular_path <- capture_glmnet_warnings(glmnet::glmnet(
      x = x_train, y = y_train, family = "binomial", alpha = best_alpha,
      standardize = TRUE
    ))
    refit_lambdas <- sort(unique(c(
      regular_path$lambda[regular_path$lambda >= best_lambda], best_lambda
    )), decreasing = TRUE)
    final_fit <- capture_glmnet_warnings(glmnet::glmnet(
      x = x_train, y = y_train, family = "binomial", alpha = best_alpha,
      lambda = refit_lambdas, standardize = TRUE
    ))
    stopifnot(final_fit$jerr == 0L)

  }

  train_prediction <- as.numeric(
    predict(
      final_fit,
      s = best_lambda,
      newx = x_train,
      type = "response"
    )
  )

  validation_prediction <- as.numeric(
    predict(
      final_fit,
      s = best_lambda,
      newx = x_validation,
      type = "response"
    )
  )

  coef_matrix <- as.matrix(
    coef(final_fit, s = best_lambda)
  )

  coef_table <- tibble(
    variable = rownames(coef_matrix),
    coefficient = coef_matrix[, 1]
  ) %>%
    filter(variable != "(Intercept)") %>%
    mutate(
      selected = coefficient != 0,
      direction = case_when(
        coefficient > 0 ~ "positive",
        coefficient < 0 ~ "negative",
        TRUE ~ "zero"
      )
    )

  list(
  alpha = best_alpha,
  lambda = best_lambda,
  cv_deviance = cv_deviance[best_index],

  train_prediction = train_prediction,
  validation_prediction = validation_prediction,

  coefficients = coef_table,

  cv_fold_diagnostics = cv_fold_diagnostics,

  glmnet_warning_n =
    length(glmnet_warnings),

  glmnet_warning_text =
    paste(
      unique(glmnet_warnings),
      collapse = " | "
    )
)
}
```

## 6.4 Calibration metrics helper

```{r}
#| label: calibration-metrics


calculate_calibration <- function(
  outcome,
  predicted_prob,
  retry_nonconvergence = FALSE
) {

  eps <- 1e-6

  p <- pmin(
    pmax(
      as.numeric(predicted_prob),
      eps
    ),
    1 - eps
  )

  lp <- qlogis(p)

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Calibration intercept
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  intercept_fit <- glm(
    outcome ~ offset(lp),
    family = binomial(),
    method = brglm2::brglmFit,
    type = "AS_mean"
  )

  calibration_intercept <-
    unname(coef(intercept_fit)[1])

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Calibration slope
  #
  # If all predictions are identical, the linear predictor has
  # zero variance and the calibration slope is not estimable.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  lp_range <- diff(range(lp))

  slope_estimable <-
    is.finite(lp_range) &&
    lp_range > 1e-12

  if (slope_estimable) {

    slope_fit <- glm(
      outcome ~ lp,
      family = binomial(),
      method = brglm2::brglmFit,
      type = "AS_mean"
    )

    if (retry_nonconvergence && !isTRUE(slope_fit$converged)) {
      slope_fit <- glm(
        outcome ~ lp, family = binomial(), method = brglm2::brglmFit,
        type = "AS_mean", control = brglm2::brglm_control(maxit = 1000L)
      )
      stopifnot(isTRUE(slope_fit$converged))
    }

    calibration_slope <-
      unname(coef(slope_fit)["lp"])

  } else {

    calibration_slope <- NA_real_
  }

  tibble(
    calibration_intercept =
      calibration_intercept,

    calibration_slope =
      calibration_slope,

    calibration_slope_estimable =
      slope_estimable
  )
}

```


## 6.5 One bootstrap iteration

This function will:
1. draw one bootstrap sample;
2. impute the development sample with outcome information available;
3. impute the original cohort as validation data with the validation outcome hidden;
4. fit the elastic net separately in each imputation;
5. average predictions across imputations;
6. calculate bootstrap-sample and validation AUC;
7. retain α, λ and coefficients.
```{r}
#| label: run-one-bootstrap

run_one_bootstrap <- function(
  data,
  outcome_var,
  predictor_vars,
  m = 3,
  bootstrap_id = 1,
  seed = 26092026
) {

  set.seed(seed + bootstrap_id)

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Draw bootstrap development sample
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  repeat {

    bootstrap_index <- sample.int(
      n = nrow(data),
      size = nrow(data),
      replace = TRUE
    )

    boot_data <- data[
      bootstrap_index,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    # Need both outcome classes present
    if (length(unique(boot_data[[outcome_var]])) == 2) {
      break
    }
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. DEVELOPMENT MI
  #
  # Postpartum outcome may help impute missing predictors.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  dev_spec <- make_mice_spec_development(
    data = boot_data,
    outcome_var = outcome_var, 
    predictor_vars = predictor_vars
  )

  dev_imp <- mice::mice(
    data = dev_spec$data,
    m = m,
    maxit = 20,
    method = dev_spec$method,
    predictorMatrix = dev_spec$predictor_matrix,
    printFlag = FALSE,
    seed = seed + bootstrap_id * 100
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. VALIDATION MI
  #
  # Original cohort is appended to bootstrap development data.
  # Validation rows are ignored when fitting imputation models.
  # Validation outcomes are hidden.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  development_for_validation <- boot_data

  validation_for_imputation <- data

  validation_for_imputation[[outcome_var]] <- NA_integer_

  combined_for_validation <- bind_rows(
    development_for_validation,
    validation_for_imputation
  )

  # FALSE = development rows used to estimate imputation models
  # TRUE  = validation rows excluded from estimating them
  validation_ignore <- c(
    rep(FALSE, nrow(development_for_validation)),
    rep(TRUE, nrow(validation_for_imputation))
  )

  val_spec <- make_mice_spec_validation(
    data = combined_for_validation,
    outcome_var = outcome_var, 
    predictor_vars = predictor_vars
  )

  val_imp <- mice::mice(
    data = val_spec$data,
    m = m,
    maxit = 20,
    method = val_spec$method,
    predictorMatrix = val_spec$predictor_matrix,
    ignore = validation_ignore,
    printFlag = FALSE,
    seed = seed + bootstrap_id * 100 + 50
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Fit model separately in each imputed dataset
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  train_pred_matrix <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = nrow(boot_data),
    ncol = m
  )

  validation_pred_matrix <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = nrow(data),
    ncol = m
  )

  tuning_list <- vector("list", m)
  coefficient_list <- vector("list", m)

  for (j in seq_len(m)) {

    # Development data
    train_j <- mice::complete(
      dev_imp,
      j
    )

    # PID is not imputed, so add it back
    train_j$pid <- boot_data$pid

    # Validation data
    validation_combined_j <- mice::complete(
      val_imp,
      j
    )

    first_validation_row <- nrow(boot_data) + 1

    validation_j <- validation_combined_j[
      first_validation_row:nrow(validation_combined_j),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    validation_j$pid <- data$pid

    # Restore the true outcome only AFTER imputation is complete
    validation_j[[outcome_var]] <-
      data[[outcome_var]]

    model_j <- fit_elastic_net(
      train_data = train_j,
      validation_data = validation_j,
      outcome_var = outcome_var,
      predictor_vars = predictor_vars,
      k = 5,
      seed = seed +
        bootstrap_id * 1000 
    )

    train_pred_matrix[, j] <-
      model_j$train_prediction

    validation_pred_matrix[, j] <-
      model_j$validation_prediction

    tuning_list[[j]] <- tibble(
      bootstrap = bootstrap_id,
      imputation = j,
      alpha = model_j$alpha,
      lambda = model_j$lambda,
      cv_deviance = model_j$cv_deviance,
      n_selected =
        sum(model_j$coefficients$selected),
      min_cv_events =
    min(
      model_j$cv_fold_diagnostics$n_events_train
    ),

  min_cv_unique_events =
    min(
      model_j$cv_fold_diagnostics$n_unique_events_train
    ),

  glmnet_warning_n =
    model_j$glmnet_warning_n,

  glmnet_warning_text =
    model_j$glmnet_warning_text
    )

    coefficient_list[[j]] <-
      model_j$coefficients %>%
      mutate(
        bootstrap = bootstrap_id,
        imputation = j
      )
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Average predicted probabilities across imputations
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  mean_train_prediction <- rowMeans(
    train_pred_matrix
  )

  mean_validation_prediction <- rowMeans(
    validation_pred_matrix
  )

  stopifnot(
    !anyNA(mean_train_prediction),
    !anyNA(mean_validation_prediction)
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Calculate discrimination
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  auc_bootstrap <- as.numeric(
    pROC::auc(
      response = boot_data[[outcome_var]],
      predictor = mean_train_prediction,
      quiet = TRUE
    )
  )

  auc_validation <- as.numeric(
    pROC::auc(
      response = data[[outcome_var]],
      predictor = mean_validation_prediction,
      quiet = TRUE
    )
  )

  
  calibration_bootstrap <- calculate_calibration(
  outcome = boot_data[[outcome_var]],
  predicted_prob = mean_train_prediction,
  retry_nonconvergence = identical(predictor_vars, full_vars)
)

calibration_validation <- calculate_calibration(
  outcome = data[[outcome_var]],
  predicted_prob = mean_validation_prediction,
  retry_nonconvergence = identical(predictor_vars, full_vars)
)


  performance <- tibble(
  bootstrap = bootstrap_id,

  auc_bootstrap = auc_bootstrap,
  auc_validation = auc_validation,

  optimism_auc =
    auc_bootstrap -
    auc_validation,

  calibration_intercept_bootstrap =
    calibration_bootstrap$calibration_intercept,

  calibration_intercept_validation =
    calibration_validation$calibration_intercept,

  optimism_calibration_intercept =
    calibration_bootstrap$calibration_intercept -
    calibration_validation$calibration_intercept,

  calibration_slope_bootstrap =
    calibration_bootstrap$calibration_slope,

  calibration_slope_validation =
    calibration_validation$calibration_slope,

  optimism_calibration_slope =
    calibration_bootstrap$calibration_slope -
    calibration_validation$calibration_slope

  )
  diagnostics <- tibble(
  bootstrap = bootstrap_id,

  n_bootstrap_rows = nrow(boot_data),

  n_unique_participants =
    n_distinct(boot_data$pid),

  n_events =
    sum(boot_data[[outcome_var]] == 1),

  n_non_events =
    sum(boot_data[[outcome_var]] == 0),

  n_unique_events =
    boot_data %>%
    distinct(pid, .data[[outcome_var]]) %>%
    summarise(
      n = sum(.data[[outcome_var]] == 1)
    ) %>%
    pull(n),

  dev_mice_logged_events =
    ifelse(
      is.null(dev_imp$loggedEvents),
      0,
      nrow(dev_imp$loggedEvents)
    ),

  val_mice_logged_events =
    ifelse(
      is.null(val_imp$loggedEvents),
      0,
      nrow(val_imp$loggedEvents)
    )
  )

  list(
  performance = performance,
  tuning = bind_rows(tuning_list),
  coefficients = bind_rows(coefficient_list),
  diagnostics = diagnostics,

  predictions = list(
    bootstrap = tibble(
      pid = boot_data$pid,
      outcome = boot_data[[outcome_var]],
      predicted_prob = mean_train_prediction
    ),

    validation = tibble(
      pid = data$pid,
      outcome = data[[outcome_var]],
      predicted_prob = mean_validation_prediction
    )
  ),

  bootstrap_index = bootstrap_index
)
}
```

### Calibration test - Run one bootstrap 
```{r}

#| label: run-bootstrap-smoke-series

run_bootstrap_series <- function(
  data,
  outcome_var,
  predictor_vars,
  B = 5,
  m = 3,
  seed = 26092026
) {

  performance_list <- vector("list", B)
  tuning_list <- vector("list", B)
  coefficient_list <- vector("list", B)
  diagnostic_list <- vector("list", B)

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {

    cat(
      "\nBootstrap",
      b,
      "of",
      B,
      "\n"
    )

    result_b <- run_one_bootstrap(
      data = data,
      outcome_var = outcome_var,
      predictor_vars = predictor_vars,
      m = m,
      bootstrap_id = b,
      seed = seed
    )

    performance_list[[b]] <-
      result_b$performance

    tuning_list[[b]] <-
      result_b$tuning

    coefficient_list[[b]] <-
      result_b$coefficients

    diagnostic_list[[b]] <-
      result_b$diagnostics
  }

  list(
    performance = bind_rows(performance_list),
    tuning = bind_rows(tuning_list),
    coefficients = bind_rows(coefficient_list),
    diagnostics = bind_rows(diagnostic_list)
  )
}
```

# 7. Paired baseline vs full model comparison

## 7.1 Integrated Discrimination Improvement

```{r}
#| label: calculate-idi

calculate_idi <- function(
  outcome,
  predicted_baseline,
  predicted_full
) {

  stopifnot(
    length(outcome) == length(predicted_baseline),
    length(outcome) == length(predicted_full)
  )

  baseline_event_mean <-
    mean(predicted_baseline[outcome == 1])

  baseline_nonevent_mean <-
    mean(predicted_baseline[outcome == 0])

  full_event_mean <-
    mean(predicted_full[outcome == 1])

  full_nonevent_mean <-
    mean(predicted_full[outcome == 0])

  discrimination_slope_baseline <-
    baseline_event_mean -
    baseline_nonevent_mean

  discrimination_slope_full <-
    full_event_mean -
    full_nonevent_mean

  idi <-
    discrimination_slope_full -
    discrimination_slope_baseline

  tibble(
    discrimination_slope_baseline =
      discrimination_slope_baseline,

    discrimination_slope_full =
      discrimination_slope_full,

    idi = idi
  )
}
```


## 7.2 One paired bootstrap iteration

```{r}
#| label: run-one-paired-bootstrap

run_one_paired_bootstrap <- function(
  data,
  outcome_var,
  baseline_vars,
  full_vars,
  m = 3,
  bootstrap_id = 1,
  seed = 26092026
) {

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. BASELINE model
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  baseline_result <- run_one_bootstrap(
    data = data,
    outcome_var = outcome_var,
    predictor_vars = baseline_vars,
    m = m,
    bootstrap_id = bootstrap_id,
    seed = seed
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. FULL model
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  full_result <- run_one_bootstrap(
    data = data,
    outcome_var = outcome_var,
    predictor_vars = full_vars,
    m = m,
    bootstrap_id = bootstrap_id,
    seed = seed
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Verify identical bootstrap samples
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  stopifnot(
    identical(
      baseline_result$bootstrap_index,
      full_result$bootstrap_index
    )
  )

  stopifnot(
    identical(
      baseline_result$predictions$bootstrap$pid,
      full_result$predictions$bootstrap$pid
    )
  )

  stopifnot(
    identical(
      baseline_result$predictions$bootstrap$outcome,
      full_result$predictions$bootstrap$outcome
    )
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Paired change in AUC
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  baseline_auc_bootstrap <-
    baseline_result$performance$auc_bootstrap

  full_auc_bootstrap <-
    full_result$performance$auc_bootstrap

  baseline_auc_validation <-
    baseline_result$performance$auc_validation

  full_auc_validation <-
    full_result$performance$auc_validation

  delta_auc_bootstrap <-
    full_auc_bootstrap -
    baseline_auc_bootstrap

  delta_auc_validation <-
    full_auc_validation -
    baseline_auc_validation

  optimism_delta_auc <-
    delta_auc_bootstrap -
    delta_auc_validation

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. IDI in bootstrap development sample
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  idi_bootstrap <- calculate_idi(
    outcome =
      baseline_result$predictions$bootstrap$outcome,

    predicted_baseline =
      baseline_result$predictions$bootstrap$predicted_prob,

    predicted_full =
      full_result$predictions$bootstrap$predicted_prob
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. IDI in original validation cohort
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  stopifnot(
    identical(
      baseline_result$predictions$validation$pid,
      full_result$predictions$validation$pid
    )
  )

  idi_validation <- calculate_idi(
    outcome =
      baseline_result$predictions$validation$outcome,

    predicted_baseline =
      baseline_result$predictions$validation$predicted_prob,

    predicted_full =
      full_result$predictions$validation$predicted_prob
  )

  optimism_idi <-
    idi_bootstrap$idi -
    idi_validation$idi

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 7. Summary
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  comparison <- tibble(
    bootstrap = bootstrap_id,

    baseline_auc_bootstrap =
      baseline_auc_bootstrap,

    full_auc_bootstrap =
      full_auc_bootstrap,

    delta_auc_bootstrap =
      delta_auc_bootstrap,

    baseline_auc_validation =
      baseline_auc_validation,

    full_auc_validation =
      full_auc_validation,

    delta_auc_validation =
      delta_auc_validation,

    optimism_delta_auc =
      optimism_delta_auc,

    baseline_discrimination_slope_bootstrap =
      idi_bootstrap$discrimination_slope_baseline,

    full_discrimination_slope_bootstrap =
      idi_bootstrap$discrimination_slope_full,

    idi_bootstrap =
      idi_bootstrap$idi,

    baseline_discrimination_slope_validation =
      idi_validation$discrimination_slope_baseline,

    full_discrimination_slope_validation =
      idi_validation$discrimination_slope_full,

    idi_validation =
      idi_validation$idi,

    optimism_idi =
      optimism_idi
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 8. Return everything needed later
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  list(
    comparison = comparison,

    performance = bind_rows(
      baseline_result$performance %>%
        mutate(model = "baseline"),

      full_result$performance %>%
        mutate(model = "full")
    ),

    tuning = bind_rows(
      baseline_result$tuning %>%
        mutate(model = "baseline"),

      full_result$tuning %>%
        mutate(model = "full")
    ),

    coefficients = bind_rows(
      baseline_result$coefficients %>%
        mutate(model = "baseline"),

      full_result$coefficients %>%
        mutate(model = "full")
    ),

    diagnostics = bind_rows(
      baseline_result$diagnostics %>%
        mutate(model = "baseline"),

      full_result$diagnostics %>%
        mutate(model = "full")
    ),

    predictions = list(
      baseline = baseline_result$predictions,
      full = full_result$predictions
    ),

    bootstrap_index =
      baseline_result$bootstrap_index
  )
}
```

# 8: Fit the apparent original-sample models and optimism correction.

```{r}
#| label: fit-apparent-model

fit_apparent_model <- function(
  data,
  outcome_var,
  predictor_vars,
  m = 10,
  seed = 26092026
) {

  # Development-style MICE:
  # outcome may be used to impute missing predictors
  apparent_spec <- make_mice_spec_development(
    data = data,
    outcome_var = outcome_var,
    predictor_vars = predictor_vars
  )

  apparent_imp <- mice::mice(
    data = apparent_spec$data,
    m = m,
    maxit = 20,
    method = apparent_spec$method,
    predictorMatrix = apparent_spec$predictor_matrix,
    printFlag = FALSE,
    seed = seed
  )

  prediction_matrix <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = nrow(data),
    ncol = m
  )

  tuning_list <- vector("list", m)
  coefficient_list <- vector("list", m)

  for (j in seq_len(m)) {

    data_j <- mice::complete(
      apparent_imp,
      j
    )

    data_j$pid <- data$pid

    model_j <- fit_elastic_net(
      train_data = data_j,
      validation_data = data_j,
      outcome_var = outcome_var,
      predictor_vars = predictor_vars,
      k = 10,
      seed = seed
    )

    prediction_matrix[, j] <-
      model_j$train_prediction

    tuning_list[[j]] <- tibble(
      imputation = j,
      alpha = model_j$alpha,
      lambda = model_j$lambda,
      n_selected =
        sum(model_j$coefficients$selected),
      glmnet_warning_n =
        model_j$glmnet_warning_n
    )

    coefficient_list[[j]] <-
      model_j$coefficients %>%
      mutate(imputation = j)
  }

  mean_prediction <- rowMeans(
    prediction_matrix
  )

  auc_apparent <- as.numeric(
    pROC::auc(
      response = data[[outcome_var]],
      predictor = mean_prediction,
      quiet = TRUE
    )
  )

  calibration_apparent <- calculate_calibration(
    outcome = data[[outcome_var]],
    predicted_prob = mean_prediction
  )

  list(
    performance = tibble(
      auc = auc_apparent,
      calibration_intercept =
        calibration_apparent$calibration_intercept,
      calibration_slope =
        calibration_apparent$calibration_slope
    ),

    predictions = tibble(
      pid = data$pid,
      outcome = data[[outcome_var]],
      predicted_prob = mean_prediction
    ),

    tuning = bind_rows(tuning_list),
    coefficients = bind_rows(coefficient_list),

    mice_logged_events =
      ifelse(
        is.null(apparent_imp$loggedEvents),
        0,
        nrow(apparent_imp$loggedEvents)
      )
  )
}
```

## 8.3 Calculate optimism-corrected performance
```{r}
#| label: calculate-optimism-corrected-performance

calculate_optimism_corrected <- function(
  apparent_baseline,
  apparent_full,
  apparent_idi,
  paired_bootstrap
) {

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Mean optimism for each model
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  model_optimism <- paired_bootstrap$performance %>%
    group_by(model) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_optimism_auc =
        mean(optimism_auc, na.rm = TRUE),

      mean_optimism_calibration_intercept =
        mean(
          optimism_calibration_intercept,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      mean_optimism_calibration_slope =
        mean(
          optimism_calibration_slope,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. Apparent model performance
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  apparent_models <- bind_rows(

    apparent_baseline$performance %>%
      mutate(model = "baseline"),

    apparent_full$performance %>%
      mutate(model = "full")
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Optimism-corrected model performance
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  corrected_models <- apparent_models %>%
    left_join(
      model_optimism,
      by = "model"
    ) %>%
    mutate(

      auc_optimism_corrected =
        auc -
        mean_optimism_auc,

      calibration_intercept_optimism_corrected =
        calibration_intercept -
        mean_optimism_calibration_intercept,

      calibration_slope_optimism_corrected =
        calibration_slope -
        mean_optimism_calibration_slope
    )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Apparent incremental value
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  apparent_delta_auc <-
    apparent_full$performance$auc -
    apparent_baseline$performance$auc

  apparent_idi_value <-
    apparent_idi$idi

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Mean optimism in incremental value
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  mean_optimism_delta_auc <-
    mean(
      paired_bootstrap$comparison$optimism_delta_auc,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

  mean_optimism_idi <-
    mean(
      paired_bootstrap$comparison$optimism_idi,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Optimism-corrected incremental value
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  corrected_comparison <- tibble(

    apparent_delta_auc =
      apparent_delta_auc,

    mean_optimism_delta_auc =
      mean_optimism_delta_auc,

    optimism_corrected_delta_auc =
      apparent_delta_auc -
      mean_optimism_delta_auc,

    apparent_idi =
      apparent_idi_value,

    mean_optimism_idi =
      mean_optimism_idi,

    optimism_corrected_idi =
      apparent_idi_value -
      mean_optimism_idi
  )

  list(
    model_performance = corrected_models,
    incremental_value = corrected_comparison
  )
}
```

# 9. Final bootstrap analysis with checkpointing
```{r}
#| label: run-paired-bootstrap-checkpointed

run_paired_bootstrap_checkpointed <- function(
    data,
    outcome_var,
    baseline_vars,
    full_vars,
    output_dir,
    outcome_label,
    B = 1000,
    m = 10,
    seed = 26092026
) {

  dir.create(
    output_dir,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {

    output_file <- file.path(
      output_dir,
      sprintf(
        "%s_bootstrap_%04d.rds",
        tolower(outcome_label),
        b
      )
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Resume safely: never repeat an already completed bootstrap
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (file.exists(output_file)) {

      cat(
        outcome_label,
        " bootstrap ",
        b,
        " already completed — skipping.\n",
        sep = ""
      )

      next
    }

    cat(
      "\n========================================\n",
      outcome_label,
      " bootstrap ",
      b,
      " of ",
      B,
      "\n========================================\n",
      sep = ""
    )

    start_time <- Sys.time()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Entire original paired bootstrap analysis
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    result_b <- run_one_paired_bootstrap(
      data = data,
      outcome_var = outcome_var,
      baseline_vars = baseline_vars,
      full_vars = full_vars,
      m = m,
      bootstrap_id = b,
      seed = seed
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Verify that all required output has been retained
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    required_elements <- c(
      "comparison",
      "performance",
      "tuning",
      "coefficients",
      "diagnostics",
      "predictions",
      "bootstrap_index"
    )

    stopifnot(
      all(
        required_elements %in%
          names(result_b)
      )
    )

    stopifnot(
      all(
        c("baseline", "full") %in%
          names(result_b$predictions)
      )
    )

    # Participant-level bootstrap predictions
    stopifnot(
      nrow(
        result_b$
          predictions$
          baseline$
          bootstrap
      ) == nrow(data),

      nrow(
        result_b$
          predictions$
          full$
          bootstrap
      ) == nrow(data)
    )

    # Participant-level predictions when the fitted bootstrap
    # models are evaluated in the original analytic sample
    stopifnot(
      nrow(
        result_b$
          predictions$
          baseline$
          validation
      ) == nrow(data),

      nrow(
        result_b$
          predictions$
          full$
          validation
      ) == nrow(data)
    )

    # Predictions required for calibration must be complete
    stopifnot(
      !anyNA(
        result_b$
          predictions$
          baseline$
          bootstrap$
          predicted_prob
      ),

      !anyNA(
        result_b$
          predictions$
          baseline$
          validation$
          predicted_prob
      ),

      !anyNA(
        result_b$
          predictions$
          full$
          bootstrap$
          predicted_prob
      ),

      !anyNA(
        result_b$
          predictions$
          full$
          validation$
          predicted_prob
      )
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Save the COMPLETE bootstrap result
    #
    # This retains:
    #   comparison
    #   performance
    #   tuning
    #   coefficients
    #   diagnostics
    #   participant-level predictions
    #   bootstrap sampling indices
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    temporary_file <- paste0(
      output_file,
      ".tmp"
    )

    saveRDS(
      result_b,
      temporary_file
    )

    if (!file.rename(
      temporary_file,
      output_file
    )) {

      stop(
        "Could not finalize bootstrap file: ",
        output_file
      )
    }

    elapsed_seconds <- as.numeric(
      difftime(
        Sys.time(),
        start_time,
        units = "secs"
      )
    )

    cat(
      "Saved bootstrap ",
      b,
      " | elapsed: ",
      round(elapsed_seconds, 1),
      " seconds\n",
      sep = ""
    )

    if (b %% 10 == 0) {

      completed <- length(
        list.files(
          output_dir,
          pattern = "\\.rds$"
        )
      )

      cat(
        "Checkpoint: ",
        completed,
        " / ",
        B,
        " complete.\n",
        sep = ""
      )
    }
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
}
```

## 10.1 Combine and save EPDS output 

```{r}
#| label: combine-epds-bootstrap-checkpoints

# Put the 1,000 checkpoint files in bootstrap order
epds_files <- epds_files[order(epds_ids)]
epds_ids   <- sort(epds_ids)

# Read all completed bootstrap objects
epds_checkpoint_objects <- lapply(
  epds_files,
  readRDS
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine the ordinary tabular outputs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

epds_comparison <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    epds_checkpoint_objects,
    `[[`,
    "comparison"
  )
)

epds_performance <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    epds_checkpoint_objects,
    `[[`,
    "performance"
  )
)

epds_tuning <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    epds_checkpoint_objects,
    `[[`,
    "tuning"
  )
)

epds_coefficients <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    epds_checkpoint_objects,
    `[[`,
    "coefficients"
  )
)

epds_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    epds_checkpoint_objects,
    `[[`,
    "diagnostics"
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine participant-level predictions
# Retain:
#   bootstrap/full vs baseline
#   development-bootstrap vs validation sample
# ------------------------------------------------------------

epds_predictions <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  epds_checkpoint_objects,
  epds_ids,
  function(x, b) {

    dplyr::bind_rows(

      x$predictions$baseline$bootstrap %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          bootstrap = b,
          model = "baseline",
          sample = "bootstrap",
          .before = 1
        ),

      x$predictions$baseline$validation %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          bootstrap = b,
          model = "baseline",
          sample = "validation",
          .before = 1
        ),

      x$predictions$full$bootstrap %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          bootstrap = b,
          model = "full",
          sample = "bootstrap",
          .before = 1
        ),

      x$predictions$full$validation %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          bootstrap = b,
          model = "full",
          sample = "validation",
          .before = 1
        )
    )
  }
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Retain the exact bootstrap sampling indices
# as a list-column: one vector of 91 indices per bootstrap
# ------------------------------------------------------------

epds_bootstrap_indices <- tibble::tibble(
  bootstrap = epds_ids,
  bootstrap_index = lapply(
    epds_checkpoint_objects,
    `[[`,
    "bootstrap_index"
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Canonical combined EPDS object
# ------------------------------------------------------------

epds_final_bootstrap <- list(
  comparison = epds_comparison,
  performance = epds_performance,
  tuning = epds_tuning,
  coefficients = epds_coefficients,
  diagnostics = epds_diagnostics,
  predictions = epds_predictions,
  bootstrap_indices = epds_bootstrap_indices
)

# Save WITHOUT deleting the 1,000 individual checkpoint files
saveRDS(
  epds_final_bootstrap,
  file.path(
    epds_bootstrap_output,
    "epds_bootstrap_combined_1000x10.rds"
  )
)
```

## 10.3 EPDS coefficient-selection stability

```{r}

#| label: verify-epds-selection-stability

epds_selection_by_bootstrap_new <-
  epds_final_bootstrap$coefficients %>%
  group_by(
    model,
    bootstrap,
    variable
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_selected = sum(selected),

    proportion_imputations_selected =
      mean(selected),

    n_positive =
      sum(selected & coefficient > 0),

    n_negative =
      sum(selected & coefficient < 0),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Majority = selected in at least 5 of 10 imputations
    majority_selected =
      n_selected >= 5,

    predominant_direction =
      case_when(
        n_positive > n_negative ~ "positive",
        n_negative > n_positive ~ "negative",
        TRUE ~ "mixed"
      )
  )


epds_bootstrap_stability_new <-
  epds_selection_by_bootstrap_new %>%
  group_by(
    model,
    variable
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_imputation_selection =
      mean(proportion_imputations_selected),

    bootstrap_majority_frequency =
      mean(majority_selected),

    n_bootstraps_majority_selected =
      sum(majority_selected),

    positive_when_majority_selected =
      sum(
        majority_selected &
          predominant_direction == "positive"
      ),

    negative_when_majority_selected =
      sum(
        majority_selected &
          predominant_direction == "negative"
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    predominant_bootstrap_direction =
      case_when(
        positive_when_majority_selected >
          negative_when_majority_selected ~ "positive",

        negative_when_majority_selected >
          positive_when_majority_selected ~ "negative",

        TRUE ~ "mixed"
      ),

    bootstrap_direction_consistency =
      if_else(
        n_bootstraps_majority_selected > 0,

        pmax(
          positive_when_majority_selected,
          negative_when_majority_selected
        ) /
          n_bootstraps_majority_selected,

        NA_real_
      )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    model,
    desc(bootstrap_majority_frequency)
  )


epds_pd_bootstrap_stability_new <-
  epds_bootstrap_stability_new %>%
  filter(
    model == "full",
    variable %in% pd_vars
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(bootstrap_majority_frequency)
  )

epds_pd_bootstrap_stability_new
```

## 10.5 EPSD calibration curves 
```{r}
## EPDS optimism-corrected calibration curves

estimate_calibration_curve <- function(
  outcome,
  predicted_prob,
  grid,
  f = 2/3
) {

  keep <-
    !is.na(outcome) &
    is.finite(predicted_prob)

  x <- as.numeric(predicted_prob[keep])
  y <- as.numeric(outcome[keep])

  # Protect against a degenerate prediction vector
  if (dplyr::n_distinct(x) < 2) {
    return(
      tibble(
        predicted_prob = grid,
        observed_prob = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }

  smooth_fit <- stats::lowess(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    f = f,
    iter = 0
  )

  # Interpolate the LOWESS estimate onto a common probability grid.
  # rule = 1 avoids extrapolation outside the observed prediction range.
  observed_grid <- stats::approx(
    x = smooth_fit$x,
    y = smooth_fit$y,
    xout = grid,
    rule = 1,
    ties = mean
  )$y

  tibble(
    predicted_prob = grid,
    observed_prob = pmin(
      pmax(observed_grid, 0),
      1
    )
  )
}



epds_calibration_grids <- list(

  baseline = seq(
    quantile(
      epds_apparent_baseline$predictions$predicted_prob,
      0.025
    ),
    quantile(
      epds_apparent_baseline$predictions$predicted_prob,
      0.975
    ),
    length.out = 101
  ),

  full = seq(
    quantile(
      epds_apparent_full$predictions$predicted_prob,
      0.025
    ),
    quantile(
      epds_apparent_full$predictions$predicted_prob,
      0.975
    ),
    length.out = 101
  )
)


# Calculate the two calibration curves
epds_apparent_calibration_curves <-
  bind_rows(

    estimate_calibration_curve(
      outcome =
        epds_apparent_baseline$predictions$outcome,
      predicted_prob =
        epds_apparent_baseline$predictions$predicted_prob,
      grid =
        epds_calibration_grids$baseline
    ) %>%
      mutate(model = "baseline", .before = 1),

    estimate_calibration_curve(
      outcome =
        epds_apparent_full$predictions$outcome,
      predicted_prob =
        epds_apparent_full$predictions$predicted_prob,
      grid =
        epds_calibration_grids$full
    ) %>%
      mutate(model = "full", .before = 1)
  )
```

### 10-bootstrap smoke test
```{r}
epds_calibration_smoke <-
  purrr::map_dfr(
    c("baseline", "full"),
    function(model_name) {

      grid <-
        epds_calibration_grids[[model_name]]

      purrr::map_dfr(
        1:10,
        function(b) {

          bootstrap_predictions <-
            epds_final_bootstrap$predictions %>%
            filter(
              bootstrap == b,
              model == model_name,
              sample == "bootstrap"
            )

          validation_predictions <-
            epds_final_bootstrap$predictions %>%
            filter(
              bootstrap == b,
              model == model_name,
              sample == "validation"
            )

          bootstrap_curve <-
            estimate_calibration_curve(
              outcome =
                bootstrap_predictions$outcome,
              predicted_prob =
                bootstrap_predictions$predicted_prob,
              grid = grid
            )

          validation_curve <-
            estimate_calibration_curve(
              outcome =
                validation_predictions$outcome,
              predicted_prob =
                validation_predictions$predicted_prob,
              grid = grid
            )

          tibble(
            bootstrap = b,
            model = model_name,
            predicted_prob = grid,
            calibration_bootstrap =
              bootstrap_curve$observed_prob,
            calibration_validation =
              validation_curve$observed_prob,
            optimism =
              calibration_bootstrap -
              calibration_validation
          )
        }
      )
    }
  )


epds_calibration_smoke %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    usable_optimism_values =
      sum(!is.na(optimism)),
    missing_optimism_values =
      sum(is.na(optimism))
  )
```

### Calculate pointwise mean optimism
```{r}
epds_calibration_optimism <-
  epds_calibration_bootstrap %>%
  group_by(
    model,
    predicted_prob
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_optimism =
      mean(optimism, na.rm = TRUE),

    n_contributing =
      sum(!is.na(optimism)),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

epds_calibration_optimism %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(
    min_contributing = min(n_contributing),
    median_contributing = median(n_contributing),
    max_contributing = max(n_contributing)
  )
```

### Construct the optimism-corrected curve
```{r}

##combine the apparent curve with the mean pointwise optimism

epds_calibration_corrected <-
  epds_apparent_calibration_curves %>%
  left_join(
    epds_calibration_optimism,
    by = c(
      "model",
      "predicted_prob"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    corrected_observed_prob_raw =
      observed_prob - mean_optimism,

    # Keep the raw value for transparency,
    # but constrain the plotted probability to [0, 1]
    corrected_observed_prob =
      pmin(
        pmax(
          corrected_observed_prob_raw,
          0
        ),
        1
      ),

    proportion_bootstraps_contributing =
      n_contributing / 1000
  )


epds_calibration_corrected %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(
    min_support =
      min(proportion_bootstraps_contributing),

    median_support =
      median(proportion_bootstraps_contributing),

    max_support =
      max(proportion_bootstraps_contributing),

    n_raw_below_zero =
      sum(corrected_observed_prob_raw < 0),

    n_raw_above_one =
      sum(corrected_observed_prob_raw > 1)
  )
```

```{r}
epds_calibration_plot <-

  # Perfect calibration
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  # Apparent calibration
  geom_line(
    aes(
      y = observed_prob,
      linetype = "Apparent"
    ),
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +

  # Optimism-corrected calibration
  geom_line(
    aes(
      y = corrected_observed_prob,
      linetype = "Optimism-corrected"

    ~ model,
    nrow = 1

  data = epds_calibration_labels,

    y = Inf,
    label = label

  hjust = -0.05,
  vjust = 1.2,

  coord_equal() +

  scale_linetype_manual(

    values = c(
      "Apparent" = "dashed",
      "Optimism-corrected" = "solid"
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Predicted probability",
    y = "Observed probability",
    caption =
      "Curves are displayed where ≥80% of bootstrap resamples contributed to the optimism estimate. Dotted line indicates perfect calibration."
  ) +

  theme_classic() +

  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
```

## 11.5 Combine the 1,000 checkpoint files
```{r}
## Combine canonical STAI-S bootstrap checkpoints

stais_files <- stais_files[order(stais_ids)]
stais_ids <- sort(stais_ids)

stais_checkpoint_objects <- lapply(
  stais_files,
  readRDS
)

stais_comparison <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(stais_checkpoint_objects, `[[`, "comparison")
)

stais_performance <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(stais_checkpoint_objects, `[[`, "performance")
)

stais_tuning <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(stais_checkpoint_objects, `[[`, "tuning")
)

stais_coefficients <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(stais_checkpoint_objects, `[[`, "coefficients")
)

stais_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(stais_checkpoint_objects, `[[`, "diagnostics")
)

stais_predictions <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  stais_checkpoint_objects,
  stais_ids,
  function(x, b) {

    dplyr::bind_rows(

      x$predictions$baseline$bootstrap %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          bootstrap = b,
          model = "baseline",
          sample = "bootstrap",
          .before = 1
        ),

      x$predictions$baseline$validation %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          bootstrap = b,
          model = "baseline",
          sample = "validation",
          .before = 1
        ),

      x$predictions$full$bootstrap %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          bootstrap = b,
          model = "full",
          sample = "bootstrap",
          .before = 1
        ),

      x$predictions$full$validation %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          bootstrap = b,
          model = "full",
          sample = "validation",
          .before = 1
        )
    )
  }
)

stais_bootstrap_indices <- tibble::tibble(
  bootstrap = stais_ids,
  bootstrap_index = lapply(
    stais_checkpoint_objects,
    `[[`,
    "bootstrap_index"
  )
)

stais_final_bootstrap <- list(
  comparison = stais_comparison,
  performance = stais_performance,
  tuning = stais_tuning,
  coefficients = stais_coefficients,
  diagnostics = stais_diagnostics,
  predictions = stais_predictions,
  bootstrap_indices = stais_bootstrap_indices
)

saveRDS(
  stais_final_bootstrap,
  file.path(
    stais_bootstrap_output,
    "stais_bootstrap_combined_1000x10.rds"
  )
)


## Verify
cat("Comparison rows:", nrow(stais_final_bootstrap$comparison), "\n")
cat("Performance rows:", nrow(stais_final_bootstrap$performance), "\n")
cat("Tuning rows:", nrow(stais_final_bootstrap$tuning), "\n")
cat("Diagnostics rows:", nrow(stais_final_bootstrap$diagnostics), "\n")
cat("Prediction rows:", nrow(stais_final_bootstrap$predictions), "\n")
cat("Bootstrap-index rows:", nrow(stais_final_bootstrap$bootstrap_indices), "\n")

cat(
  "Missing prediction probabilities:",
  sum(is.na(stais_final_bootstrap$predictions$predicted_prob)),
  "\n"
)

stais_final_bootstrap$predictions %>%
  count(model, sample)

# Expected prediction rows: 364,000
```

## 11.8 Recalculate selection stability
```{r}
stais_selection_by_bootstrap <-
  stais_final_bootstrap$coefficients %>%
  group_by(
    model,
    bootstrap,
    variable
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_selected = sum(selected),

    proportion_imputations_selected =
      mean(selected),

    n_positive =
      sum(selected & coefficient > 0),

    n_negative =
      sum(selected & coefficient < 0),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    majority_selected =
      n_selected >= 5,

    predominant_direction =
      case_when(
        n_positive > n_negative ~ "positive",
        n_negative > n_positive ~ "negative",
        TRUE ~ "mixed"
      )
  )


stais_bootstrap_stability <-
  stais_selection_by_bootstrap %>%
  group_by(
    model,
    variable
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_imputation_selection =
      mean(proportion_imputations_selected),

    bootstrap_majority_frequency =
      mean(majority_selected),

    n_bootstraps_majority_selected =
      sum(majority_selected),

    positive_when_majority_selected =
      sum(
        majority_selected &
          predominant_direction == "positive"
      ),

    negative_when_majority_selected =
      sum(
        majority_selected &
          predominant_direction == "negative"
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    predominant_bootstrap_direction =
      case_when(
        positive_when_majority_selected >
          negative_when_majority_selected ~ "positive",

        negative_when_majority_selected >
          positive_when_majority_selected ~ "negative",

        TRUE ~ "mixed"
      ),

    bootstrap_direction_consistency =
      if_else(
        n_bootstraps_majority_selected > 0,

        pmax(
          positive_when_majority_selected,
          negative_when_majority_selected
        ) /
          n_bootstraps_majority_selected,

        NA_real_
      )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    model,
    desc(bootstrap_majority_frequency)
  )


stais_pd_bootstrap_stability <-
  stais_bootstrap_stability %>%
  filter(
    model == "full",
    variable %in% pd_vars
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(bootstrap_majority_frequency)
  )

stais_pd_bootstrap_stability
```

## 11.9 STAI-S optimism-corrected calibration curves
```{r}
stais_calibration_grids <- list(

  baseline = seq(
    quantile(
      stais_apparent_baseline$predictions$predicted_prob,
      0.025
    ),
    quantile(
      stais_apparent_baseline$predictions$predicted_prob,
      0.975
    ),
    length.out = 101
  ),

  full = seq(
    quantile(
      stais_apparent_full$predictions$predicted_prob,
      0.025
    ),
    quantile(
      stais_apparent_full$predictions$predicted_prob,
      0.975
    ),
    length.out = 101
  )
)

#Apparent curves
stais_apparent_calibration_curves <-
  bind_rows(

    estimate_calibration_curve(
      outcome =
        stais_apparent_baseline$predictions$outcome,
      predicted_prob =
        stais_apparent_baseline$predictions$predicted_prob,
      grid =
        stais_calibration_grids$baseline
    ) %>%
      mutate(model = "baseline", .before = 1),

    estimate_calibration_curve(
      outcome =
        stais_apparent_full$predictions$outcome,
      predicted_prob =
        stais_apparent_full$predictions$predicted_prob,
      grid =
        stais_calibration_grids$full
    ) %>%
      mutate(model = "full", .before = 1)
  )


## 1000 bootstrap curves
stais_calibration_bootstrap <-
  purrr::map_dfr(
    c("baseline", "full"),
    function(model_name) {

      grid <-
        stais_calibration_grids[[model_name]]

      purrr::map_dfr(
        1:1000,
        function(b) {

          bootstrap_predictions <-
            stais_final_bootstrap$predictions %>%
            filter(
              bootstrap == b,
              model == model_name,
              sample == "bootstrap"
            )

          validation_predictions <-
            stais_final_bootstrap$predictions %>%
            filter(
              bootstrap == b,
              model == model_name,
              sample == "validation"
            )

          bootstrap_curve <-
            estimate_calibration_curve(
              outcome =
                bootstrap_predictions$outcome,
              predicted_prob =
                bootstrap_predictions$predicted_prob,
              grid = grid
            )

          validation_curve <-
            estimate_calibration_curve(
              outcome =
                validation_predictions$outcome,
              predicted_prob =
                validation_predictions$predicted_prob,
              grid = grid
            )

          tibble(
            bootstrap = b,
            model = model_name,
            predicted_prob = grid,

            calibration_bootstrap =
              bootstrap_curve$observed_prob,

            calibration_validation =
              validation_curve$observed_prob,

            optimism =
              calibration_bootstrap -
              calibration_validation
          )
        }
      )
    }
  )



```


### Save
```{r}
saveRDS(
  stais_calibration_bootstrap,
  file.path(
    stais_bootstrap_output,
    "stais_calibration_bootstrap_curves.rds"
  )
)
```


## 11.10 Calculate the corrected curve and support
```{r}
stais_calibration_optimism <-
  stais_calibration_bootstrap %>%
  group_by(
    model,
    predicted_prob
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_optimism =
      mean(optimism, na.rm = TRUE),

    n_contributing =
      sum(!is.na(optimism)),

    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


## 11.12 Construct corrected curves:
```{r}
stais_calibration_corrected <-
  stais_apparent_calibration_curves %>%
  left_join(
    stais_calibration_optimism,
    by = c(
      "model",
      "predicted_prob"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    corrected_observed_prob_raw =
      observed_prob - mean_optimism,

    corrected_observed_prob =
      pmin(
        pmax(
          corrected_observed_prob_raw,
          0
        ),
        1
      ),

    proportion_bootstraps_contributing =
      n_contributing / 1000
  )

saveRDS(
  stais_calibration_corrected,
  file.path(
    stais_bootstrap_output,
    "stais_calibration_corrected_curve.rds"
  )
)
```

```{r}
  pattern = "^stait_bootstrap_[0-9]{4}\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

stait_ids <- as.integer(
  sub(
    ".*_([0-9]{4})\\.rds$",
    "\\1",
    basename(stait_files)
  )
)

cat("Number of completed files:", length(stait_files), "\n")
cat("Missing bootstrap IDs:", setdiff(1:1000, stait_ids), "\n")
cat("Duplicated IDs:", anyDuplicated(stait_ids), "\n")

tmp_files <- list.files(
  stait_bootstrap_output,
  pattern = "\\.tmp$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

cat("Temporary files remaining:", length(tmp_files), "\n")

```

### Combine the 1,000 canonical STAI-T checkpoints
```{r}
## Combine canonical STAI-T bootstrap checkpoints

stait_files <- stait_files[order(stait_ids)]
stait_ids <- sort(stait_ids)

stait_checkpoint_objects <- lapply(
  stait_files,
  readRDS
)

stait_comparison <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(stait_checkpoint_objects, `[[`, "comparison")
)

stait_performance <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(stait_checkpoint_objects, `[[`, "performance")
)

stait_tuning <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(stait_checkpoint_objects, `[[`, "tuning")
)

stait_coefficients <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(stait_checkpoint_objects, `[[`, "coefficients")
)

stait_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(stait_checkpoint_objects, `[[`, "diagnostics")
)

stait_predictions <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  stait_checkpoint_objects,
  stait_ids,
  function(x, b) {

    dplyr::bind_rows(

      x$predictions$baseline$bootstrap %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          bootstrap = b,
          model = "baseline",
          sample = "bootstrap",
          .before = 1
        ),

      x$predictions$baseline$validation %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          bootstrap = b,
          model = "baseline",
          sample = "validation",
          .before = 1
        ),

      x$predictions$full$bootstrap %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          bootstrap = b,
          model = "full",
          sample = "bootstrap",
          .before = 1
        ),

      x$predictions$full$validation %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          bootstrap = b,
          model = "full",
          sample = "validation",
          .before = 1
        )
    )
  }
)

stait_bootstrap_indices <- tibble::tibble(
  bootstrap = stait_ids,
  bootstrap_index = lapply(
    stait_checkpoint_objects,
    `[[`,
    "bootstrap_index"
  )
)

stait_final_bootstrap <- list(
  comparison = stait_comparison,
  performance = stait_performance,
  tuning = stait_tuning,
  coefficients = stait_coefficients,
  diagnostics = stait_diagnostics,
  predictions = stait_predictions,
  bootstrap_indices = stait_bootstrap_indices
)
```

## 12.7 STAI-T predictor-selection stability
```{r}


stait_selection_by_bootstrap <-
  stait_final_bootstrap$coefficients %>%
  group_by(
    model,
    bootstrap,
    variable
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_selected = sum(selected),

    proportion_imputations_selected =
      mean(selected),

    n_positive =
      sum(selected & coefficient > 0),

    n_negative =
      sum(selected & coefficient < 0),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    majority_selected =
      n_selected >= 5,

    predominant_direction =
      case_when(
        n_positive > n_negative ~ "positive",
        n_negative > n_positive ~ "negative",
        TRUE ~ "mixed"
      )
  )


stait_bootstrap_stability <-
  stait_selection_by_bootstrap %>%
  group_by(
    model,
    variable
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_imputation_selection =
      mean(proportion_imputations_selected),

    bootstrap_majority_frequency =
      mean(majority_selected),

    n_bootstraps_majority_selected =
      sum(majority_selected),

    positive_when_majority_selected =
      sum(
        majority_selected &
          predominant_direction == "positive"
      ),

    negative_when_majority_selected =
      sum(
        majority_selected &
          predominant_direction == "negative"
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    predominant_bootstrap_direction =
      case_when(
        positive_when_majority_selected >
          negative_when_majority_selected ~ "positive",

        negative_when_majority_selected >
          positive_when_majority_selected ~ "negative",

        TRUE ~ "mixed"
      ),

    bootstrap_direction_consistency =
      if_else(
        n_bootstraps_majority_selected > 0,

        pmax(
          positive_when_majority_selected,
          negative_when_majority_selected
        ) /
          n_bootstraps_majority_selected,

        NA_real_
      )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    model,
    desc(bootstrap_majority_frequency)
  )


stait_pd_bootstrap_stability <-
  stait_bootstrap_stability %>%
  filter(
    model == "full",
    variable %in% pd_vars
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(bootstrap_majority_frequency)
  )

stait_pd_bootstrap_stability
```

## 12.8 STAI-T calibration
```{r}


stait_calibration_grids <- list(

  baseline = seq(
    quantile(
      stait_apparent_baseline$predictions$predicted_prob,
      0.025
    ),
    quantile(
      stait_apparent_baseline$predictions$predicted_prob,
      0.975
    ),
    length.out = 101
  ),

  full = seq(
    quantile(
      stait_apparent_full$predictions$predicted_prob,
      0.025
    ),
    quantile(
      stait_apparent_full$predictions$predicted_prob,
      0.975
    ),
    length.out = 101
  )
)


stait_apparent_calibration_curves <-
  bind_rows(

    estimate_calibration_curve(
      outcome =
        stait_apparent_baseline$predictions$outcome,
      predicted_prob =
        stait_apparent_baseline$predictions$predicted_prob,
      grid =
        stait_calibration_grids$baseline
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        model = "baseline",
        .before = 1
      ),

    estimate_calibration_curve(
      outcome =
        stait_apparent_full$predictions$outcome,
      predicted_prob =
        stait_apparent_full$predictions$predicted_prob,
      grid =
        stait_calibration_grids$full
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        model = "full",
        .before = 1
      )
  )

stait_apparent_calibration_curves


## Bootstrap calibration curves
stait_calibration_bootstrap <-
  purrr::map_dfr(
    c("baseline", "full"),
    function(model_name) {

      grid <-
        stait_calibration_grids[[model_name]]

      purrr::map_dfr(
        1:1000,
        function(b) {

          bootstrap_predictions <-
            stait_final_bootstrap$predictions %>%
            filter(
              bootstrap == b,
              model == model_name,
              sample == "bootstrap"
            )

          validation_predictions <-
            stait_final_bootstrap$predictions %>%
            filter(
              bootstrap == b,
              model == model_name,
              sample == "validation"
            )

          bootstrap_curve <-
            estimate_calibration_curve(
              outcome =
                bootstrap_predictions$outcome,
              predicted_prob =
                bootstrap_predictions$predicted_prob,
              grid = grid
            )

          validation_curve <-
            estimate_calibration_curve(
              outcome =
                validation_predictions$outcome,
              predicted_prob =
                validation_predictions$predicted_prob,
              grid = grid
            )

          tibble(
            bootstrap = b,
            model = model_name,
            predicted_prob = grid,

            calibration_bootstrap =
              bootstrap_curve$observed_prob,

            calibration_validation =
              validation_curve$observed_prob,

            optimism =
              calibration_bootstrap -
              calibration_validation
          )
        }
      )
    }
  )

## Pointwise optimism 
stait_calibration_optimism <-
  stait_calibration_bootstrap %>%
  group_by(
    model,
    predicted_prob
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_optimism =
      mean(optimism, na.rm = TRUE),

    n_contributing =
      sum(!is.na(optimism)),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


## Corrected curves
stait_calibration_corrected <-
  stait_apparent_calibration_curves %>%
  left_join(
    stait_calibration_optimism,
    by = c(
      "model",
      "predicted_prob"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    corrected_observed_prob_raw =
      observed_prob - mean_optimism,

    corrected_observed_prob =
      pmin(
        pmax(
          corrected_observed_prob_raw,
          0
        ),
        1
      ),

    proportion_bootstraps_contributing =
      n_contributing / 1000
  )
```

```{r}
stait_calibration_support_ranges <-

  summarise(
    apparent_min =

    apparent_max =
      max(predicted_prob),

    min_90 =
      min(
        predicted_prob[
          proportion_bootstraps_contributing >= 0.90
        ]
      ),

    max_90 =
      max(
        predicted_prob[
          proportion_bootstraps_contributing >= 0.90
        ]
      ),

    min_80 =

        ]
      ),

    max_80 =
      max(
        predicted_prob[
          proportion_bootstraps_contributing >= 0.80
```

## Create calibration plot
```{r}
stait_calibration_plot <-
  ggplot(
    stait_calibration_plot_data,
    aes(x = predicted_prob)
  ) +

  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  geom_line(
    aes(
      y = observed_prob,
      linetype = "Apparent"
    ),
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +

  geom_line(
    aes(
      y = corrected_observed_prob,
      linetype = "Optimism-corrected"
    ),
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ model,
    nrow = 1
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = stait_calibration_labels,
    aes(
      x = -Inf,
      y = Inf,
      label = label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = -0.05,
    vjust = 1.2,
    size = 3.5
  ) +

  coord_equal() +

  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      "Apparent" = "dashed",
      "Optimism-corrected" = "solid"
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Predicted probability",
    y = "Observed probability",
    caption =
      "Curves are displayed where ≥80% of bootstrap resamples contributed to the optimism estimate. Dotted line indicates perfect calibration."
  ) +

  theme_classic() +

  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
