## 13.2 Master predictor stability table
```{r}
# 13.3 Cross-outcome PD predictor-selection stability

master_pd_stability_long <-
  bind_rows(

    epds_pd_bootstrap_stability %>%
      mutate(outcome = "EPDS"),

    stais_pd_bootstrap_stability %>%
      mutate(outcome = "STAI-S"),

    stait_pd_bootstrap_stability %>%
      mutate(outcome = "STAI-T")
  ) %>%
  mutate(

    outcome = factor(
      outcome,
      levels = c("EPDS", "STAI-S", "STAI-T")
    ),

    # Variables ending in 2 are late-pregnancy measures
    timepoint = if_else(
      grepl("2$", variable),
      "Late pregnancy",
      "Early pregnancy"
    ),

    # Paired underlying PD measure code
    measure_code = sub("2$", "", variable),

    selection_frequency_percent =
      100 * bootstrap_majority_frequency,

    direction_consistency_percent =
      100 * bootstrap_direction_consistency
  ) %>%
  select(
    outcome,
    variable,
    measure_code,
    timepoint,
    mean_imputation_selection,
    selection_frequency_percent,
    n_bootstraps_majority_selected,
    predominant_bootstrap_direction,
    direction_consistency_percent
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    measure_code,
    timepoint,
    outcome
  )

master_pd_stability_long
```

```{r}
master_pd_stability_table <-

    pd_measure = recode(
      measure_code,
      "PARDiff" = "Dilation at Response",
      "RodDiff" = "Net Pupil Change",
      "PCUDiff" = "Early Peak Pupil Change",
      "PAADiff" = "Late Sustained Dilation",
      "PTRDiff" = "Early Mean Pupil Size"
    )

  select(
    pd_measure,
    timepoint,
    outcome,
    selection_frequency_percent,
    predominant_bootstrap_direction,
    direction_consistency_percent

  pivot_wider(
    names_from = outcome,
    values_from = c(
      selection_frequency_percent,
      predominant_bootstrap_direction,
      direction_consistency_percent

    names_glue = "{outcome}_{.value}"

  arrange(
    factor(
      pd_measure,
      levels = c(
        "Early Mean Pupil Size",
        "Early Peak Pupil Change",
        "Late Sustained Dilation",
        "Dilation at Response",
        "Net Pupil Change"
      )
    ),
    factor(
      timepoint,
      levels = c(
        "Early pregnancy",
        "Late pregnancy"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
    stais_calibration_plot_data %>%
      mutate(outcome = "STAI-S"),

    stait_calibration_plot_data %>%
      mutate(outcome = "STAI-T")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = factor(
      outcome,
      levels = c("EPDS", "STAI-S", "STAI-T")
    ),

    model = factor(
      model,
      levels = c(
        "Baseline model",
        "Full model (+ PD)"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
master_calibration_plot <-

) +

  facet_grid(
    outcome ~ model
  ) +

    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,

    size = 3.2

  coord_equal() +

  scale_linetype_manual(

  )
) +

scale_color_manual(
  name = NULL,

    "Apparent" = "#D55E00",
    "Optimism-corrected" = "#0072B2"
  )
)  +

  labs(
    x = "Predicted probability",
    y = "Observed probability",
    caption =
      "Curves are displayed where ≥80% of bootstrap resamples contributed to the optimism estimate. Dotted line indicates perfect calibration."
  ) +

  theme_classic() +

  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",

    strip.text.x =
      element_text(face = "bold"),

    strip.text.y =
      element_text(face = "bold"),

    strip.background =
      element_rect(
        fill = "white",
        colour = "black"
      )
  )
```

# 14 Sample-size/model-complexity assessment 

## 14.1 Install/load pmsampsize
```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("pmsampsize", quietly = TRUE)) {
  renv::install("pmsampsize")
}

library(pmsampsize)
```

### 14.2 Define the scenarios
```{r}
# 14. Formal sample-size adequacy assessment

sample_size_inputs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~outcome, ~events, ~prevalence,
  "EPDS",   13L,     13/91,
  "STAI-S", 12L,     12/91,
  "STAI-T", 21L,     21/91
)

candidate_cstats <- c(
  0.70,
  0.75,
  0.80
)

sample_size_scenarios <-
  tidyr::crossing(
    sample_size_inputs,
    model = c("baseline", "full"),
    cstatistic = candidate_cstats
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    parameters = if_else(
      model == "baseline",
      32L,
      42L
    )
  )

sample_size_scenarios
```


### 14.3 Run the calculations
```{r}
pmsampsize_results <-
  purrr::pmap(
    sample_size_scenarios,
    function(
      outcome,
      events,
      prevalence,
      model,
      cstatistic,
      parameters
    ) {

      pmsampsize::pmsampsize(
        type = "b",
        cstatistic = cstatistic,
        parameters = parameters,
        prevalence = prevalence,
        shrinkage = 0.90
      )
    }
  )
```

### 14.4 Make one readable summary
```{r}
pmsampsize_summary <-
  purrr::map2_dfr(
    seq_len(nrow(sample_size_scenarios)),
    pmsampsize_results,
    function(i, result) {

      scenario <-
        sample_size_scenarios[i, ]

      tibble(
        outcome =
          scenario$outcome,

        model =
          scenario$model,

        parameters =
          scenario$parameters,

        prevalence =
          scenario$prevalence,

        observed_events =
          scenario$events,

        assumed_cstatistic =
          scenario$cstatistic,

        estimated_cox_snell_r2 =
          result$rsquared,

        minimum_sample_size =
          result$sample_size,

        required_events =
          ceiling(result$events),

        required_EPP =
          result$EPP,

        final_shrinkage =
          result$final_shrinkage,

        observed_sample_size =
          91L,

        sample_size_shortfall =
          result$sample_size - 91L,

        observed_EPP =
          scenario$events /
          scenario$parameters
      )
    }
  )

pmsampsize_summary

```
### Save
```{r}
readr::write_csv(
  pmsampsize_summary,
  here(
    "output",
    "tables",
    "pmsampsize_sensitivity_analysis.csv"
  )
)
```

### Create compact table
```{r}
pmsampsize_primary_summary <-
  pmsampsize_summary %>%
  filter(assumed_cstatistic == 0.75) %>%
  select(
    outcome,
    model,
    parameters,
    prevalence,
    observed_events,
    observed_EPP,
    minimum_sample_size,
    required_events,
    required_EPP
  )

pmsampsize_primary_summary

  here(
    "output",
    "tables",
    "pmsampsize_primary_summary.csv"
  )
)
```
